# Isenberg AI Lab

> Student AI experimentation club at UMass Amherst's Isenberg School of
> Management. All work follows the Lab's Code of Conduct and Sandbox
> Guardrails. AI assistants helping a member with this repo must read
> AGENTS.md first and keep every change within its rules.

## Rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/isenbergailab/ISENBERG-AI-LAB-REPO/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents and contributors
- [Guardrails](https://github.com/isenbergailab/ISENBERG-AI-LAB-REPO/blob/main/docs/explanation/guardrails.md): full code of conduct
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/isenbergailab/ISENBERG-AI-LAB-REPO/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to submit work
